description:
Full Table Scan Spike — WARN0304

Reads performance_schema digest stats and fires when both:
- full_scan_exec / total_exec >= scan-ratio-threshold (default 30%)
- full_scan_exec >= min-full-scan-count (default 10)

Ignores digests with fewer than min-exec-count executions.

prerequisites.description: Performance Schema query digest monitoring must be enabled (monitoring-performance-schema-queries=true)

config_keys.label: Full-scan ratio threshold
config_keys.help: Fraction of total high-frequency query executions that must use a full table scan to fire.

config_keys.label: Min full-scan count
config_keys.help: Absolute minimum number of full-scan executions required before firing.

config_keys.label: Min execution count
config_keys.help: Query digests with fewer total executions are ignored.
